extension.description: Live TV, archive and guide from the service.tvlink add-on. Based on pvr.tvlink by Alex@ELEC; does not depend on the AlexELEC image.
Прямой эфир, архив и телегид из дополнения service.tvlink. Основан на pvr.tvlink от Alex@ELEC и не зависит от образа AlexELEC.
extension.news: v22.1.5 - Builds for Windows x86_64, Android aarch64/armv7 and macOS (x86_64 + arm64) v22.1.4 - Settings: fields service.tvlink always overwrites are hidden (still defined) v22.1.3 - DASH channels (#KODIPROP:inputstream=inputstream.adaptive from service.tvlink) play through inputstream.adaptive v22.1.2 - Live stream read without Kodi's stream buffer: channel switch no longer waits for the next segment v22.1.1 - Instance created by the add-on class: survives Kodi creating the client twice (was "Not implemented") v22.1.0 - pvr.sublime: own id, built outside the AlexELEC image - Startup: retry the playlist until the server answers (was: wait for the next refresh hour) v22.0.6 - Epg: add parsed EPG-cache binary file v22.0.5 - Epg: optimize download xmltv-file based on TVLINK xmltv.status v22.0.4 - Del: option Use FFmpeg playlist v22.0.3 - Set: one option Use Inputstream FFmpeg Direct v22.0.2 - Add: always play EPG Tags as live-stream v22.0.1 - Fix: Timeshift/Catchup v22.0.0 - Init: first version for Kodi-22 (Piers)
